blocker_recorded: Missing reference-specific motional parameters and physical-envelope mismatch prevent a sourced runtime binding.
blocker_resolution: Not closable. The archived AB Revised 10.29.2018 sheet (https://abracon.com/Resonators/ab.pdf, read in full) gives only R1 max (35 ohm for the selected bin), C0 max (7 pF), CL (18 pF), drive level, tolerance/stability, aging. It gives no C1, L1, Q, C0/C1 ratio, pullability or trim sensitivity. There is no standard method that derives the motional capacitance/inductance from ESR, C0 and CL: those are independent of C1 (C1 needs Q with R1, or trim sensitivity TS=C1/(2(C0+CL)^2), or a measured pullability). Class template X{ref} {A} {B} ohm_xtal L1 C1 R1 C0 therefore cannot be filled with sourced values; the only way to compile it would be the class C1 default (basis ASSUMPTION, 9fF) plus a derived L1, which would not identify this crystal and is rejected. A web search for an Abracon primary motional-parameter document or SPICE model for this family found only distributor/aggregator pages (secondary). Physical-envelope blocker also stands: reference body 11.5 x 5.0 x 13.46 mm (p1 header) versus the library HC-49/U envelope; nothing in the sheet resolves it. Existing values re-checked against Table 1: 8.000-9.999 MHz fundamental HC49/U ESR 35 ohm, C0 7 pF, CL 18 pF, DL 100 typ/1000 max uW are correct. Note: the AB 'Quality Factor' field is a custom-order option (QXXXk minimum), not a standard-part specification, so it cannot supply Q.

blocker_recorded: Unresolved rating-critical output/thermal data and physical mismatch.
blocker_resolution: Not closable from the exact-part source. The archived AST3TQ53 sheet (Revised 2.16.2021, all 7 pages read; live URL re-fetched, same revision) has no start-up time, no output-current limit, no junction temperature and no thermal resistance; maximum ratings are only storage temp, supply -0.5..6 V, control voltage, ESD. The OHM-146 pattern needs sourced tstart (template parameter, delay before output), supply_abs_max, rth_ja and tj_max; only supply_abs_max (6 V), recommended supply (3.135..3.465 V) and Icc max (10 mA, no load, no typical and no test frequency) exist. Using the class tstart default (5 ms, sourced for SiT8008/S11) or SiT8008 thermal data would be borrowing another part's facts. Additional mismatch the binding would also have to handle: pin1 is NC for the T option (no OE), so the ohm_xo OE input would need an internal tie, and the class ppm parameter is a static offset while this part is a +/-100 ppb TCXO. Physical mismatch also stands: selected post-02/10/2021 drawing 5.20x3.40 mm (p1 header says 5.0x3.2x1.6) vs library 3.2x2.5 mm TCXO.

blocker_recorded: Input-power/DC rating interpretation and complete source-mask model validation unresolved.
blocker_resolution: Partly closed, overall still blocked. (1) Mask validation: I ran the authored ohm_saw.lib (unchanged, ngspice, 50/50 ohm, 800..940 MHz, 20001 pts). All four sourced relative-attenuation minima pass with margin (825-828: 64.1 dB vs 40; 846-849: 44.9 vs 35; 889-892: 44.3 vs 35; 910-913: 62.9 vs 40; reference = min passband IL, identical to IL at Fc). Ripple 0.52 dB <= 1.5. But insertion loss across the sourced passband 865..873 MHz is 4.50 dB at Fc rising to 5.02 dB at the edges, so the model EXCEEDS the 'Insertion Loss @ Passband' 4.5 dB max by about 0.52 dB at the band edges (passes only if the spec is read as at-Fc). The model is conservative but not mask-compliant; fixing it means regenerating the class lib (e.g. il_db so that passband max <= 4.5) which touches locked bench B1 (il_fc 4.5), outside this task. (2) Rating interpretation: the only primary sheet (undated, single page, rendered and inspected) prints DC Voltage 10 V and Source Power 10 dBm as values merged across the MIN/TYP/MAX columns, with no 'maximum' or 'absolute rating' label; the live URL serves the same document. This cannot be honestly upgraded to an absolute maximum. (3) Infrastructure: the class is ac-only and runtime recipes only accept op/tran, so no runtime recipe can be bound or probed without a schema and probe extension.
